note: Rewritten from the original description of Holmgren (1913), published as a new form, M. suluensis f. rubriceps, and treated here as a subspecies of zuluensis following BSF; the original is in German, measurements in mm. Only the soldier and worker are described; type locality Mkosi, Zululand.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier as in the typical form, the mandibles perhaps slightly stouter, but the head red-brown and the anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements: head length including mandibles 1.98 mm, head length without mandibles 1.29 mm, head width 0.84 mm. Head of the major worker almost orange-yellow, head width 0.72 mm; head width of the minor worker 0.65 mm.
